preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100.
The number of elements in the list a must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a_i <= 50 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each element in the list a must be between 0 and 50.

postconditions.description: The output must contain n+1 strings.
Each string in the output must have a length of at most 200.

postconditions.expression: all(len(s[i][:a[i]]) == len(s[i+1][:a[i]]) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The length of the longest common prefix of s_i and s_{i+1} must be equal to a_i.
